notes: Reached via Chrome connector throughout, no WAF encountered. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only /cart,/checkout,/account,/search,/login and sort/filter query params). Site is a Next.js/commercetools (Frontastic) storefront; mega-nav shows a top-level 'Furniture' department (alongside Chandeliers & Pendants, Bath & Wall Lights, Ceiling Lights, Fans, Outdoor Lights, Lamps & Shades, Mirrors & Decor, Rugs, New & Inspiring, Sale). TREE SOURCE: the site's own taxonomy service (storefront-solstorefront.frontastic.live/frontastic/action/product/queryCategories, paginated 500/request via cursor=offset:N, 4192 categories total) was fetched and filtered to the 'FURNITURE' root node (categoryKey='furniture', depth 0), which has exactly 20 depth-1 children and only one depth-2 grandchild (Clearance Sale Furniture, under All Furniture - excluded as Sale/Clearance junk per rule 3). Cross-checked against the category sitemap (sitemap-categories-1/2.xml, 200 indexed category URLs) - no additional furniture nodes found beyond the 20 already known; the sitemap also revealed a separate 'Farmhouse Furniture' node at taxonomy depth 3 (under a Style branch, not under the Furniture root), confirming that sibling node 'Modern & Contemporary Furniture' is likewise a cross-cutting STYLE facet rather than a genuine product-type category (see exclusions below). QTY SOURCE (rule 1): the rendered PLP header 'N items' - the product grid and its count are entirely client-rendered (no static count in initial HTML/SSR, confirmed by inspecting document.documentElement.outerHTML for 'total'/'numFound' - none present), so each category page was loaded in the tab and the header text was read after full hydration. TRAP ENCOUNTERED: this app throws a client-side React hydration error (minified error #419, a Suspense/hydration timeout) when the tab is backgrounded (document.visibilityState='hidden') by the shared multi-worker browser, leaving a blank grid or - more subtly - silently displaying the PREVIOUS page's cached DOM under the NEW page's URL (confirmed via location.href mismatch and same-origin fetch() with redirect:'follow' proving no real HTTP redirect occurred). Fix used throughout: take a screenshot immediately after navigate to force the tab to the foreground, then wait ~4-6s before reading; any category that still read null/stale was hard-reloaded via a second navigate call. EXCLUSIONS from the 20 candidate children: 'All Furniture' (rule-3 navigation junk, the department's own aggregate listing); 'Dressers & Chests' (slug dressers-chests is a genuine 301 redirect - verified via fetch(...).redirected===true - to /categories/accent-cabinets-with-doors, i.e. the node has no live listing page of its own on this build, so it was dropped rather than reported under the wrong URL); 'Coffee & Side Tables' (slug coffee-side-tables 301-redirects to /categories/end-side-tables, a duplicate/merged alias of the already-captured End & Side Tables node); 'Modern & Contemporary Furniture' (280 of ~589 total counted furniture items, and the page's own left-rail facet reads 'Style: Modern & Contemporary (280)' - this is a style filter applied across the whole department, not a distinct product type, and would double-count against every other row). RULE 0: kept Bathroom Vanity Cabinets & Sinks (14) - sampled products are all '_ Bath Vanity'/'_ Vanity' cabinet units, i.e. furniture, not fixtures; kept Storage & Display Cabinets, Sideboards & Buffets, Accent Cabinets as furniture cabinetry; kept Outdoor Furniture & Accessories (58) - sampled products are all outdoor tables/sofas/chairs/stools/ottomans, no non-furniture accessories seen on the first page. No further nesting exists under any of the 16 kept leaves (checked programmatically: none of their categoryKeys appear as a parentKey anywhere in the 4192-node taxonomy), so the whole tree is flat - one 'Furniture' bucket with 16 sibling leaves, no grouping rows needed. Sanity checks: every leaf's qty is distinct in origin (independently read from its own hydrated page, title/breadcrumb verified to match the intended category on every read) and none are suspiciously round; qty values range 10-122, no single value dominates.
